sentences.en: Mozart was greater than any other composer of his time.
sentences.zh: 莫扎特比他那个时代的任何作曲家都要伟大。

sentences.en: Paul is not so much a singer as a composer.
sentences.zh: 保罗与其说是一个歌手不如说是一个作曲家。

sentences.en: I rate him among the best modern composers in Japan.
sentences.zh: 我把他列为日本最优秀的现代作曲家之一。

senses.zh: （尤指古典音乐）作曲家,调停人,设计者
